run_DefaultTeacher: run the DefaultTeacher class to load and serve qangaroo QA examples from JSON data files
create_WikiHopTeacher: create a WikiHopTeacher instance to load WikiHop dataset examples for multi-hop reasoning tasks
create_MaskedWikiHopTeacher: create a MaskedWikiHopTeacher instance to load masked WikiHop dataset examples for ablation studies
create_MedHopTeacher: create a MedHopTeacher instance to load MedHop medical multi-hop QA dataset examples
review_DefaultTeacher_get: review the DefaultTeacher get method that returns action dicts with text, labels, and supports
